name: r5_bound_natprod_049
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();s=(p/'src/URMatchingAvoidanceBound.lean').read_text().replace('  have h := Finset.prod_le_prod hf','''  have hp (k : ℕ) :
      (∀ i < k, 4 * (N-b-i) ≤ 3 * (N-i)) →
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, 4 * (N-b-i)) ≤ (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, 3 * (N-i)) := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hh
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, Finset.prod_range_succ]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul (ih (fun i hi => hh i (Nat.lt.step hi))) (hh k (Nat.lt_succ_self k))
  have h := hp a (fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi))''')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingAvoidanceBound.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
